_comment: LANE M target set. Each entry names the production files whose CHECKS we want measured, the invariant those checks are supposed to defend, and the functions to rank first. Adding a module here is how the nightly grows; nothing outside this list is ever mutated.

load_gate._comment: MACHINE DISCIPLINE. A measurement taken under load is void: this project has withdrawn a full day of verdicts to that exact confound, so the engine refuses to measure until the 1-minute load is under the ceiling. The ceiling is the standard; sleep_s only decides how often the machine is re-sampled, and sampling more often only makes it likelier that a genuinely quiet moment is used.

budgets._comment: Selection budget, not a chain-state bound: it decides how many mutants one nightly pass affords. Recorded in every manifest so a score is never read as a full census.

pow.invariant: I-4 FORK CHOICE INTEGRITY (only VERIFIED work moves the tip)

consensus.invariant: I-4 + I-1 (the admission equality that binds header.work; shape bounds)

mempool.invariant: I-2 NO DOUBLE SPEND (refusal by a SET, never by luck)

node_tx_doors._comment: §3.8 — node.rs joins the target set. It was excluded during the closure round (correct file discipline) and leaving it excluded is a permanent blind HALF: B3, B4, C-H1, C-H2, C-H3, C-H4, D-7, E-2, E-3, E-5 and E-7 all live here. AFFORDABILITY IS BY SCOPE, NOT BY TRUNCATION — `focus_only` measures the DOORS this target names (node.rs holds 653 check-bearing sites across 124 check-bearing functions; a 12-per-file budget over all of them is the N-2 defect, a budget silently deciding which door stays defended in file order).
node_tx_doors.invariant: I-1 + I-2 — the transaction admission doors. Row B3 is this target's calibration: `ingest_tx_prechecked` omitted the `chain_object::admissible` its sibling `ingest_tx` ran.

node_block_doors.invariant: I-4 FORK CHOICE INTEGRITY — every door a BLOCK enters by. Rows E-8 (the descent door carried merkle and parents and NOT the PoW check) and D-2 (`instant_sync` ran no PoW on carried blocks) are both empty cells of this family's matrix.

node_adopt_doors.invariant: I-4 + I-1 — the DSYNC adopt surface and the sidecar door. C-H2/C-H3 (`adopt_sidecar_row` refuses only an ordinal conflict while recv/del bytes reach the fold sink) and A3/A5 (fields riding the proof unbound) live here; the binding half is enumerated build-free by tools/harness/bind/enumerate.py.

node_runtime_pages.invariant: I-6(c) + I-1 — the page-application loops. Row C-H1 is this target's calibration: `pump_parked_page` offers every entry to `accept_fetched_record`, counts the verdict, and then applies the WHOLE page. Found by M3's verdict-dataflow pass, not by a mutant — there is no check there to break.

door_families._comment: §3.7/M2 — THE DOOR TABLE. A family is one class of object and every door it enters by. `doors.py` also GENERATES families from name siblings (`ingest_tx` / `ingest_tx_prechecked`), so a door added with a familiar suffix joins its family with nobody editing this file; the entries below are the families whose members do NOT share a name, which a generator cannot see. An EMPTY CELL is the finding; a FILLED cell is where M2 injects.

tx_admission.calibration: B3 — against src/node.rs.preDoorAudit-20260907 this family MUST report the empty cell `ingest_tx_prechecked !-> admissible`, and MUST report none against the live tree. MEASURED 2026-09-08: it does both.

block_ingress._doors_comment: ⛔⛔ A DOOR TABLE THAT NAMES ONLY TODAY'S SPELLING CANNOT REPRODUCE YESTERDAY'S HOLE — measured 2026-09-08, and it is the reason two calibration rows read NO against a generator that answers them both. `--at preDescentLane-20260907` reported NOTHING for this family because the descent door was called `graft_wanted_block_shell` then and `graft_block_shell_from_trusted_id` was the rename the FIX introduced: the family evaluated to one door, and one door has no siblings to be missing a check against. Pointed at the historical name the SAME generator prints `graft_wanted_block_shell !-> verify_block_pow` on the pre-fix tree — E-8's exact cell, the design's stated self-proof. The wrapper still exists, so naming it here costs nothing and the row re-measures forever. `instant_sync` is the same omission for D-2: not a member of any declared family and not a name-sibling of anything, so the adopt door's PoW column was a cell nobody could look at. MEASURED both directions: pre-fix `instant_sync !-> verify_block_pow, !-> preverify_block` with no cell the other way; live, those two persist while `ingest_block !-> header_grind_admits / header_door_admits / hash_meets_target / bundle_blocks_admitted` appear — the fix is visible AS the reversal. THE RULE THIS ENCODES: a door is retired from this table by DELETING THE FUNCTION, never by renaming it, because the table is the only thing that remembers a door existed.
block_ingress.calibration: E-8 — the descent door's missing PoW check is an empty cell of this row. MEASURED 2026-09-08: `mutate.py matrix --target node_block_doors --at preDescentLane-20260907 --expect-empty-cells 'graft_wanted_block_shell!->verify_block_pow'` -> CALIBRATION HELD. D-2 is the same column at the adopt door and re-measures with `--expect-empty-cells 'instant_sync!->verify_block_pow'` at the same point.
block_ingress._checks_comment: The columns are what the BLOCK CLASS requires, declared. Without them the row reports every way a bundle-admission door differs from a full ingest (14 cells, 13 of them legitimate) and buries the one that matters. E-8 is the `verify_block_pow`/`hash_meets_target` column; D-2 is the same column at the adopt door.

graft_seam.calibration: B4 / E-2 — the graft-side loop that applies without the filter its sibling uses.

_warm_dir_note: Lane-scoped on purpose: another lane already uses ~/.cargo-targets/harness itself as a cargo target directory, and two lanes writing debug/ and deps/ into one directory is a collision waiting to be diagnosed as something else. This engine keeps its clone, its build dir and its results under one subdirectory it owns.

_calibration._comment: THE HARNESS'S OWN STANDARD (docs/harness-design.md Part D): a capability is not built until it REPRODUCES a known-missed calibration row. Every line below was MEASURED 2026-09-08 and is the command that re-measures it. A capability whose command stops reproducing its row has regressed, whatever else is green.
_calibration._comparator_note: ⛔ `--expect-empty-cells` COMPARES EXACTLY, in both directions, as of 2026-09-08. It used to be a CONTAINMENT test while `--help` promised an exact one, which made every negative control in this block a tautology (∅ ⊆ anything). The commands below therefore name the WHOLE measured declared set, not just the row's own cell — that is the point: a cell that appears because the tree grew a new door difference now FAILS the calibration instead of hiding inside a passing run. When a command fails on an unexpected cell, adjudicate that cell and add it here, or close it. Never delete a cell from these lists to make a run green.

B3's own cell is `ingest_tx_prechecked!->admissible`; it is ABSENT from the live tree's set, which is the half that proves the instrument is trustworthy in both directions.

E-8's own cell is `graft_wanted_block_shell!->verify_block_pow`. ⛔ THIS COMMAND REPORTED NOTHING AT ALL until the door table learned the door's HISTORICAL name — see `door_families.block_ingress._doors_comment`.
_calibration.D-2 · instant_sync ran no PoW on the blo: the same pre-fix command above also measures `instant_sync!->verify_block_pow` and `instant_sync!->preverify_block`.
